Class SocketVirtualView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.server.SocketVirtualView
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObserver, Remote
public class SocketVirtualView extends Object implements GameObserver
Acts as a virtual view on the server side for a client connected via TCP Socket. It implements the GameObserver interface, translating model events and controller requests into plain-text protocol strings or JSON payloads sent over the socket.
